stage.value: managing their subscription during a temporary closure

job.value: pause their CarouBiz subscription instead of cancelling it

arrivedFrom.value: their CarouBiz plan from Me or settings

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The first screen is a 'Monthly CarouBiz Lite' benefits list ('General quota 42/50', 'Video listing'), with nothing about pausing.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: Pausing is reachable only through the unlabelled '⋮' at the top right, while 'Manage quota' and 'Create' links dominate.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Manage quota', 'Create' and 'Choose a plan' predict their result, but the '⋮' gives no hint it holds pause or cancel.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'General quota' and 'Listing insertions' each carry a plain one-line explanation.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The screen asks for no decisions.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Every one of nine benefits shows a description sentence up front, though that suits a plan overview.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: The 'Need more? Upgrade to a CarouBiz plan' block with 'Choose a plan' is aimed at upgrading, not at someone wanting to pause.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Each benefit carries a full sentence like 'Organise your shop in a way that will make customers browse your shops the most'.
